evidence: Illustrative design assumptions for sensitivity arithmetic, not measured lunar performance or a facility specification. All biological rates and yields below are assumptions; sources motivate the questions, not the chosen numbers.
preferred_endpoint: Autonomous freshwater recruitment in the established ecosystem, without obligatory hatchery intervention; saline production is transitional and a controlled freshwater life cycle is an intermediate milestone.

reading_rules.fcr: Dry feed supplied divided by net stage biomass gain (outgoing live biomass minus incoming live biomass). Economic FCR includes feed lost and mortality effects; do not add a second mortality feed multiplier. This is not a claim of constant FCR as survival changes.
reading_rules.composition: Use the same assumed wet whole-fish N and P content at entry and exit. Nonretained material includes uneaten feed, mortalities, dissolved excretion and solids; it is not all water discharge.
reading_rules.oxygen: Separate instantaneous standing-stock calculation. Fish respiration excludes nitrification and other biological demand. The latter excludes fish and nitrifiers. Basal nitrogen excretion and delayed decomposition are unresolved; feed-proportional terms do not model fasting or system upsets. The capacity factor is a design allowance, not a proven peak multiplier. Nitrification coefficients are oxidation-only stoichiometry from E10; other coefficients are assumptions.
reading_rules.hatchery: Batch yield is a planning assumption motivated by E08, not a validated count at the assumed cycle time or survival. Nominal water inventory is a separate hydraulic unit, not the volume of a 1000-glass-eel tank. Salt calculation assumes density 1000 kg/m3, tracks liquid losses, and excludes evaporation losses of salt.
reading_rules.freshwater: The 0.14 g/kg case is a physical inventory comparison only. No successful egg or larval performance is assigned to it; the actual calcium-bicarbonate ion recipe and magnesium floor remain unresolved.
reading_rules.scope: Feed and nutrient totals start at glass-eel entry. Broodstock, egg and larval feed, their wastes/oxygen/energy, and processing energy remain unquantified, not zero. Cooked fish excludes sauce, rice and coproduct credits. No annual yield per area or profitability is estimated.
